subject: Labproof run plan — throughput & latency execution for FinexCo onboarding
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Cross <natalie@finexco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Labproof run plan — throughput & latency execution for FinexCo onboarding

Hi Natalie,

Thanks again for committing time for the joint run. To make the evidence packet robust for your procurement team I want to confirm the objectives and the exact plan for the test window. High level goals: 

- Acceptance targets (per our SLOs agreed in onboarding call):
  • P50 latency <= 120 ms (in-region)
  • P95 latency <= 350 ms
  • Sustained throughput target: 250 req/s for the text-generation endpoint for 10 minutes
- Run artifacts to capture: token-level traces, per-host CPU/GPU utilization, autoscaler events, and raw request/response samples (redacted).

Proposed execution window: Wed Jun 16, 10:00–12:00 PDT (we'll run two 20-minute sustained windows with a warmup). Please confirm or propose alternatives.

Key asks from your side before we start:
1) Provide the test dataset or a sampling rule we can use for synthetic queries.
2) Confirm the endpoint URL and auth token we should hit during the run.
3) Any IP allowlist or scheduled security scans we should know about.

Attachments: finexco_api_spec_v1.pdf (API surface & rate limits).

If that looks good I'll schedule the run with engineering and share the runbook + load harness.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Natalie Cross <natalie@finexco.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Liu <aaron.liu@finexco.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Labproof run plan — throughput & latency execution for FinexCo onboarding

Monica,

Thanks — Wed Jun 16 10:00–12:00 PDT works for us. Endpoint and creds below (test-key; I'll rotate post-run):
- Endpoint: https://api-test.finexco.com/v1/generate
- Auth: Bearer test-finex-2027

We will provide a de-identified sample payload folder by EOD today (attachment: finexco_test_records.zip). Security note: we have an internal IDS that will flag >3000 connections/min from a single IP; we will open a temporary allowlist for Redwood agent IPs for the run window.

One ask on our side: we'd like to capture a short walkthrough of the collected artifacts for our infra/security team after the run. Can someone from engineering join a 30-min debrief?

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Natalie Cross <natalie@finexco.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Labproof run plan — throughput & latency execution for FinexCo onboarding

Thanks Natalie — noted on the allowlist. A couple of details from our side before the run: 

- We'll run two sustained phases: 5-min ramp, 10-min steady, 5-min ramp-down. During steady-state we'll target 250 req/s aggregate.
- Please confirm if sampling should include attachments or only the request body; we'll redact any PII before sharing artifacts.
- We'll perform a prefix warmup to populate KV caches for your common prompts. If you have a short list of 10 representative prompts please share — otherwise we'll use the top-10 from the sample payload.

I've attached the load harness script we'll run on our side (attachment: redwood_load_script_v2.sh). Vivek — can you own the cold-cache warmup knobs and the autoscaler log capture?

From: Natalie Cross <natalie@finexco.com>

Cc: Aaron Liu <aaron.liu@finexco.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Labproof run plan — throughput & latency execution for FinexCo onboarding

Folks,

We completed the two steady-state windows as planned. Summary of observed metrics (attached full CSV: finexco_run_20270616_summary.csv):
- Throughput: steady at 248–255 req/s (meets target)
- P50 latency: 110 ms (within target)
- P95 latency: 420 ms (above target of 350 ms)
- Notable: tail spikes aligned with autoscaler scale-up events and a brief GC on one host at 10:34:12.

We captured the tracer and scaling logs you requested. I've uploaded the raw artifacts to our secure share and attached the per-request summary CSV. We're happy to join a 30-min debrief — interested in recommendations to reduce the P95.

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Cross <natalie@finexco.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Labproof run plan — throughput & latency execution for FinexCo onboarding

Hi all — thanks for the quick turnaround and detailed artifacts. Short read on acceptance and next steps: 

- What passed: throughput and p50 targets are met — good result.
- What needs work: p95 at 420 ms > 350 ms acceptance threshold. Root-cause indicators: autoscaler activity during steady-state and a single-host GC/pause event.

Recommended immediate actions (proposed owners & timeline):
1) Cache warmup expansion — Vivek to update warmup to include additional prompt prefixes and increase pre-warm time to 3 minutes (owner: vivek@redwood.com) — ETA: Jun 17 EOD.
2) Autoscaler smoothing — Ben to adjust the scale-up policy to a slightly earlier trigger and extend cool-down (owner: ben@redwood.com) — ETA: Jun 17 midday.
3) Re-run proof window — target: Fri Jun 18 09:00–10:30 PDT (monitored by Redwood + FinexCo). Monica will schedule and coordinate the 30-min debrief immediately after.

If we hit p95 <= 350 ms on the re-run we'll consider the performance acceptance satisfied and prepare the evidence packet for procurement. Attaching a consolidated evidence packet template: onboarding-evidence-packet.pdf.
